verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a first-party Status Pages product that shows real-time operational status and incident-resolution status from within PagerDuty as the single source of truth. That covers the core of a status page tied to incident state. However, the evidence never mentions public hosting, custom domains or subscriber notifications. Missing for 10: custom domain support, subscriber notification/subscription mechanics, explicit public-facing hosted page evidence, detail on how incident state drives page updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can publish a hosted public status page — custom domain, subscriber notifications — driven from incident state

citations.quote: PagerDuty Status Pages provide visual, real-time insights into an organization's operations, and the status of incident resolution.
PagerDuty users can proactively and securely communicate real-time operational updates without context switching to other tools, giving users one platform, PagerDuty, as the single source of truth.
